answer: Hold unpredictable live deliberation: at random times, small groups must meet synchronously to argue a question drawn on the spot. One operator cannot be present in many rooms at once, speaking distinctly in each, so a farm's puppets collide — they miss sessions, echo one another, or fall silent. In an open meadow, every plant must catch the same sun; presence cannot be stockpiled. Past transcripts are a relic anyone can audit for copied phrasing, and standing lives in no vault of old deeds, but is earned again at each meeting.
